maya: Quick sanity check — we've started seeing quality regressions when speculative decode falls back to the quant-70b path. Can we run a crossover eval to measure oracle fallback vs heuristic (timeout) fallback?

liam: +1. Can you sketch the metrics you want? I care about aggregate quality but also per-prompt-bucket failure modes.

maya: Sketch: EM-like and ROUGE/bertscore proxies, but also token-level divergence (first mismatched token position), latency delta, and a classification of failure modes (syntax break, hallucination, truncation). Buckets: short Qs (<40 tok), long context (>512), code snippets, safety-triggered prompts. Run 2k prompts per bucket if possible.

anya: For heuristic fallback we've been using: if speculative hasn't produced next token within 40ms -> route to quant fallback. We also experimented with a "soft backoff" where after fallback we switch to a slower model for N tokens then try to rejoin. Current config snippet:```yaml
speculative:
  timeout_ms: 40
  fallback_strategy: soft_backoff
  soft_backoff_tokens: 8
```

zack: How do we define oracle? Two options: 1) run spec+quant paired online and pick the higher-quality result post-hoc; 2) run paired offline and compare token-by-token. Paired runs are easier to reason about.

maya: I vote paired offline — run both models deterministically on same RNG seeds (or sampling seeds) so we can attribute differences. Example call:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.internal-infer/run \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"prompt":"<prompt>","models":["spec-7b","quant-70b"],"mode":"paired","seed":42}'
```

ops-bot: paired-inference-job/2740007777 started on batch-3. ETA ~6hrs.

liam: Add derived metrics: weighted_regress = max(0, quant_score - spec_score). Track top-1% of regressions for manual review. Also compute false-positive hallucination rate (cases where spec hallucinated but quant didn't).

anya: Small runtime note — speculative sometimes cuts off mid-token with certain samplers (we saw a partial UTF-8 sequence). If fallback happens mid-token, we should replay from last safe token rather than trying to stitch bytes. Patch idea: mark last_safe_token when sampler commits token boundary; on fallback, replay from last_safe_token.

maya: Good catch. I'll add that to the test harness. Plan: I will kick off 2k paired runs per bucket tonight, then produce summary: per-bucket regressions, latency distributions, and examples for manual triage. If we see >0.8% regression rate in short Qs we'll disable this speculative profile for that model.

zack: I can script the prompt stratifier and the CSV exporter (prompt_id, bucket, spec_out, quant_out, token_divergence, spec_latency_ms, quant_latency_ms). Would you like it attached to the job?

maya: Yes please — attach CSVs to the job output and include a minimal HTML diff viewer for reviewers.

zack: Will do.

maya: Thanks all — tagging @ops for higher IO priority if the job spikes.
